publicOpenPRs.body:
Existing financial tests compare selected fields and leave raw statement references, typed values and public output bytes uncovered. Add two integration tests that compare the two complete parsed financial Programs and six real ordinary/metered CLI reports against independently frozen expectations. They retain all 39 unique statement steps, 23 ordered effects and the actual invoice successor-state link.

The 32 expected payloads were frozen before test-author consumption and copied byte for byte. Production code and dependencies are unchanged. Formatting and static copy/hash checks passed; one exact frozen normative excerpt retains its blank EOF line. Actual parser/CLI execution is unrun pending the new bounded command and its two independent reviews. Compiler, SDK, proof, ledger and parent roadmap exits remain open.
